BACKGROUND INFORMATION: Denzel Crous was appointed as the chief financial officer (CFO) on a 2-year contract which will be reviewed on 31 August 2025. He is also a shareholder in Venus Ltd. NOTE: Where comments or explanations are required, you should: • Quote financial indicators and trends with figures • Give a reason or an explanation for the financial indicators quoted INFORMATION: 3.1 Choose the correct word from those given in brackets. (3 x 1) (3) 3.2 Liquidity: The liquidity position of the company has improved. Quote TWO financial indicators with figures to support this statement.
